high_level_description: The image depicts two individuals walking through an airport terminal. The setting is the arrival area, as indicated by the yellow sign with "Arrival A1" written on it. The background shows a glass wall with reflections of the terminal's interior and some signage displaying flight information. The person on the left appears to be a man wearing a light purple shirt, white pants, and black sneakers. He has a cast or brace on his right arm and is also wearing a black ankle brace. He is carrying a gray shoulder bag.
